reported.title: Missing debounce for button press
reported.description: The button press is not properly debounced, which could lead to multiple horn blasts due to contact bounce. The SETTLE_MS value is not sufficient to handle the maximum bounce time of 10 ms.

reported.title: Blocking delay in horn blast
reported.description: The delay in the blast function blocks the loop, preventing the heartbeat from being printed during the horn blast duration, which could lead to missed beats.

judge_input.spec:
- Horn relay on D12; dock button on D4 with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- A settled press on D4 sounds the horn: D12 HIGH for 60 ms, starting within 100 ms of the press.
- Contact bounce up to 10 ms on press and release must not sound the horn twice.
- A press that is still held after the horn stops does not sound it again.
- D12 stays LOW whenever no press has been accepted.
- Print `dock <n>` every 500 ms ±150 ms, with n counting the lines printed.
